from pathlib import Path
bin_dir = Path(".venv/bin")
old = "#!/Users/amin/dev/p-projects/armenia/resume/.venv/bin/python3.14"
new = "#!/Users/amin/dev/p-projects/armenia/kuchup/.venv/bin/python3.14"
fixed = []
for path in bin_dir.iterdir():
    if not path.is_file():
        continue
    try:
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="strict")
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, OSError):
        continue
    if text.startswith(old):
        path.write_text(new + text[len(old):], encoding="utf-8")
        fixed.append(path.name)
print("fixed", len(fixed), "scripts")
print("\n".join(fixed[:20]))
PY
